'''''Manihot grahamii''''' is a shrub or treelet in the family [[Euphorbiaceae]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Rogers|first=David J.|last2=Appan|first2=S. G.|date=1973|title=Manihot Manihotoides (Euphorbiaceae)|journal=Flora Neotropica|volume=13|pages=1–272}}</ref>

This fast-growing species is closely related to ''[[Manihot esculenta]]'', the edible [[tapioca]]. Growing up to {{convert|3|m|ft|abbr=off|frac=2}} tall, it bears striking palmate [[leaves]], and pale green bell-shaped flowers in summer.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/269603/manihot-grahamii/details | title = ''Manihot Graham ii'' | publisher = RHS | access-date = 15 August 2022}}</ref> It is native to [[South America]], including southern Brazil, Uruguay, Paraguay and Argentina.<ref>Rogers, D. J. & S. G. Appan. 1973. Manihot, Manihotoides (Euphorbiaceae). Fl. Neotrop. Monogr. 13: 1–274.</ref><ref>Jørgensen, P. M., M. H. Nee, S. G. Beck & A.F. Fuentes. 2015 en adelante. Catalogo de las plantas vasculares de Bolivia (actualizaciones en línea).</ref><ref>Forzza, R. C. 2010. Lista de espécies Flora do Brasil <nowiki>http://floradobrasil.jbrj.gov.br/2010</nowiki>. Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro.</ref>
